11.t: Working with data: write a conclusion
q: At which temperature did the seeds take longest to germinate?
How many days faster did seeds germinate at 20 degrees C than at 10 degrees C?
Write a conclusion sentence that describes the trend and uses data.
As the temperature increased from 10 to 25 degrees C, the mean time to germinate decreased from 12 to 4 days; above 25 degrees C it stayed at 4 days.
Does the evidence support the hypothesis? Evaluate, using the results at 25 and 30 degrees C.

Partly: warmer soil gave faster germination up to 25 degrees C, as predicted. But 25 and 30 degrees C gave the same time, so above about 25 degrees C warmth no longer speeds it up. The hypothesis should say "up to a point".
